freeze_gate.reason: Only OULAD passes the reviewed license/access/adult-projection boundary, and it is education-only structured behavior. It cannot support the required life-continuity semantics or multilingual public text. No dataset or cases may be frozen from this matrix.

eligible_supplement_only.operator: The Open University / UCI Machine Learning Repository
eligible_supplement_only.license_evidence: UCI metadata and The Open University release page state CC BY 4.0.
eligible_supplement_only.access: Official static ZIP; no login, API key, profile route, search route, or paid provider required.
eligible_supplement_only.robots_api_boundary: Use only the official dataset page/static archive route; do not crawl participant or profile pages.
eligible_supplement_only.human_evidence: Source-provided anonymized daily VLE activity aggregates from real learners; no public text.
eligible_supplement_only.privacy_evidence: Publisher reports anonymization using k-anonymity and l-diversity.
eligible_supplement_only.projection_boundary: Eligibility may be checked ephemerally from age_band 35-55 or 55<=. A release must omit learner ID, module/presentation, age band, assessment, mark, outcome, region, gender, disability, education, deprivation, exact date, and every other demographic field.
eligible_supplement_only.deletion_boundary: Regenerate from a revised upstream snapshot and remove matching non-reversible generalized profiles; retain content-free dataset-local tombstones only.
limitations: cannot prove preference evolution, relationship change, unfinished life items, recurring life events, or corrections

rejected_or_unverified.reason: The official repository makes the corpus downloadable but does not publish an explicit dataset redistribution license. Worker-linked personal prose also presents unresolved re-identification and withdrawal risks.
The official README prohibits redistribution without separate permission; ratings also do not provide the required public textual life evidence.

The release consists of one diary per participant rather than a multi-observation longitudinal subject, and the published participant code embeds demographic/location information prohibited by this contract.
Full journal text is controlled-access and the documented cohort includes participants aged 15-17. It is neither a public redistributable 35+ corpus nor safe for this freeze.

The study is framed around young adults rather than a verifiable 35+ cohort, and the reviewed public route did not establish an eligible multi-entry participant projection. A CC BY label alone does not satisfy the age and identity gates.

Longitudinal linkage relies on public usernames, account IDs, URLs, or cross-post combinations that remain re-identifiable; deletion propagation and participant consent are not adequate for a frozen benchmark.
Private or controlled-access data is outside scope, and public release cannot be inferred from research access.
Minors are present or subjects aged 35 and older cannot be reliably isolated before persistence.
